{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Step 1: Filter for completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Step 2: Parse revenue — strip commas and convert to float
completed['revenue_parsed'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 3: Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_clean = completed[completed['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99]

# Step 4: Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_parsed'].mean()

print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}')
print(f'Number of QA orders removed: {len(completed) - len(completed_clean)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
